title: AMBA APB completer: a 256-word memory with a wait-state region and a PSLVERR region

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: a transfer to the reserved region (paddr[11] set) completed with PSLVERR

notes: psel, penable, paddr, pwrite, pwdata, prdata, pready and pslverr are the completer pins of the IP's own APB port (the subject of the IP, separate from the register port); they pass through unchanged. The registers report the completer's error events.

Address map seen on the IP's port (paddr[11:10]): 00 memory, no wait state; 01 the same memory with one wait state; 1x reserved, PSLVERR (writes ignored, reads 0). paddr[9:2] selects the word; other bits are ignored.
